case.user: Show the unit circle and explain what sine is

input.intent: Explain what sine is, using the unit circle: for an angle theta measured from the positive x-axis, sin(theta) is the y-coordinate of the point where the ray meets the circle of radius 1; show that the vertical leg equals sin(theta), give the values at 0, 30, 45, 60, 90 degrees, and note sine ranges between -1 and 1.

text: The unit circle is on the table with sine explained alongside it — sine of an angle is the height (y-coordinate) where the ray hits the circle of radius 1.
